title: Settings via environment variables
body:
## Goal
Add `app/settings.py` (pydantic-settings or plain dataclass + os.environ) for CORS origins, chunk size/overlap, top-k default and provider selection; use it in `create_app`.

## Acceptance criteria
- Defaults keep current behaviour
- Tests cover env overrides
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Structured JSON logging and request IDs
body:
## Goal
Add a logging setup that emits JSON lines and a middleware that sets/propagates an `X-Request-ID` header.

## Acceptance criteria
- Request ID echoed in responses
- Test asserts header round-trip
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Consistent error responses
body:
## Goal
Return errors as `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }` for validation, not-found and unexpected errors, documented in OpenAPI.

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests for 404, 422 and 500 shapes
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Markdown and HTML loaders
body:
## Goal
Add `app/loaders.py` with `load_markdown` and `load_html` that turn content into clean text plus metadata (title, headings), and an `/ingest/file` endpoint accepting `.md`, `.html`, `.txt` uploads.

## Acceptance criteria
- No network in tests
- Script/style tags stripped from HTML
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: PDF loader (optional dependency)
body:
## Goal
Support `.pdf` uploads via `pypdf` as an optional dependency; return a clear 415 error when it isn't installed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Test with a tiny generated PDF fixture
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Recursive, heading-aware chunking
body:
## Goal
Add a chunking strategy that splits on headings, then paragraphs, then sentences before falling back to word windows; keep the current strategy as default and select via settings.

## Acceptance criteria
- Chunks never exceed the size limit
- Tests on a Markdown fixture
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Chunk metadata and source spans
body:
## Goal
Store `start`/`end` character offsets and the nearest heading for each chunk and return them in `/query` sources.

## Acceptance criteria
- Offsets map back to the original text in tests
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Persistent SQLite vector store
body:
## Goal
Add `SQLiteVectorStore` (stdlib `sqlite3`, vectors as JSON or float blobs, brute-force cosine) selectable via settings, so data survives restarts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Same test suite runs against both stores
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: BM25 keyword index and hybrid search
body:
## Goal
Implement a small BM25 index and a hybrid search that merges BM25 and vector scores with reciprocal rank fusion; expose `mode=vector|keyword|hybrid` on `/query`.

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests show hybrid fixes a keyword-only query
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Metadata filters on query
body:
## Goal
Allow `/query` to filter by `doc_id` list and title substring before ranking.

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests for each filter
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Voyage AI embeddings adapter
body:
## Goal
Add `VoyageEmbedder` behind the `Embedder` protocol using `httpx`, enabled when `VOYAGE_API_KEY` is set; HashingEmbedder remains the default.

## Acceptance criteria
- HTTP mocked in tests (no network)
- README documents the env var
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: OpenAI-compatible embeddings adapter
body:
## Goal
Add an embeddings adapter for any OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` endpoint (base URL + key + model via env).

## Acceptance criteria
- Mocked HTTP tests
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Claude answerer
body:
## Goal
Add `ClaudeAnswerer` (Anthropic Messages API via `httpx`) that answers only from the retrieved sources, cites them as `[n]`, and says it doesn't know when sources don't support an answer. Enabled when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set.

## Acceptance criteria
- Prompt template in its own module
- Mocked HTTP tests, including the refusal path
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Streaming answers over SSE
body:
## Goal
Add `POST /query/stream` returning Server-Sent Events (`sources`, `token`, `done`) for answerers that support streaming; the extractive answerer streams sentence by sentence.

## Acceptance criteria
- Test reads the event stream with TestClient
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Citation validation
body:
## Goal
Post-process answers so every `[n]` refers to an existing source and strip invalid ones; report `unsupported: true` when no valid citation remains.

## Acceptance criteria
- Unit tests for valid, invalid and missing citations
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Prompt-injection guardrail for retrieved text
body:
## Goal
Wrap retrieved chunks in clearly delimited, escaped blocks and instruct the model to treat them as data; add tests that injected instructions in documents are passed through as quoted content.

## Acceptance criteria
- Tests with a malicious fixture document
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Streaming chat UI
body:
## Goal
Turn the ask form into a chat thread that renders `/query/stream` events incrementally, with a stop button and accessible live region.

## Acceptance criteria
- Keyboard accessible
- Falls back to `/query` when streaming is unavailable
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Source preview panel
body:
## Goal
Clicking a citation opens a side panel with the full chunk, its document title and score; Esc closes it and focus returns to the citation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Focus management tested manually and documented
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Document manager
body:
## Goal
List ingested documents (new `GET /documents` endpoint) with chunk counts and a delete button with confirmation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Backend endpoint + tests
- UI updates after delete
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: File upload with drag and drop
body:
## Goal
Upload `.md/.html/.txt/.pdf` files to `/ingest/file` with progress and error states.

## Acceptance criteria
- Works with keyboard (file input) as well as drag and drop
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Theme toggle and design polish
body:
## Goal
Add a light/dark/system theme toggle stored in `localStorage` (guarded), refine spacing and typography, and add an empty state with example questions.

## Acceptance criteria
- No layout shift on load
- Contrast meets WCAG AA
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Retrieval evaluation harness
body:
## Goal
Add `backend/evals/` with a small fixture corpus + question set and a script computing recall@k and MRR for the current pipeline; print a table.

## Acceptance criteria
- Runs offline in < 10 s
- Documented in docs/evals.md
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Answer faithfulness checks
body:
## Goal
Extend the eval harness with a simple faithfulness metric: share of answer sentences whose words are mostly covered by cited sources.

## Acceptance criteria
- Unit tests for the metric
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Compare chunking strategies in evals
body:
## Goal
Run the harness for each chunking strategy and chunk size, and write results to `docs/evals.md`.

## Acceptance criteria
- Table committed to docs
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Docker Compose with Postgres + pgvector
body:
## Goal
Add a pgvector-backed store adapter and a compose profile running Postgres with the extension; keep in-memory as default.

## Acceptance criteria
- Adapter unit-tested with a fake connection
- `docker compose --profile pgvector up` documented
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: API key auth and rate limiting
body:
## Goal
Optional `API_KEYS` env var enabling `Authorization: Bearer` checks and a simple in-memory token-bucket rate limiter.

## Acceptance criteria
- Disabled by default
- Tests for 401 and 429
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Deploy guide: Fly.io / Render + Vercel
body:
## Goal
Write `docs/deploy.md` covering backend on Fly.io or Render and frontend on Vercel, including env vars and CORS.

## Acceptance criteria
- Linked from README
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Architecture deep-dive
body:
## Goal
Write `docs/architecture.md` explaining each pipeline stage, the protocols, and how to add a provider, with a sequence diagram.

## Acceptance criteria
- Linked from README
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: WordPress connector (via REST API)
body:
## Goal
Add a script `backend/scripts/ingest_wordpress.py` that pulls posts from a WordPress site's REST API (paginated) and ingests them; link to wp-headless-kit for the JS side.

## Acceptance criteria
- HTTP mocked in tests
- README section
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes

title: Launch article draft: building a RAG starter you can read in an afternoon
body:
## Goal
Write `docs/articles/introducing-rag-starter.md` (900–1300 words) on the design: offline defaults, protocols, citations, evals. The maintainer publishes it.

## Acceptance criteria
- Code samples match the current API
- `bash scripts/check.sh` passes
